headline: Bitcoin Slips Under $60,000 Amid Outflows and Altcoin Declines
summary: Bitcoin fell back below $60,000 as altcoins dropped and fund outflows headed toward nearly $5 billion, marking its worst monthly performance since June 2022.
why: Bitcoin is the largest digital asset by market capitalization and serves as a primary sentiment and liquidity gauge for the broader cryptocurrency market.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Heavy fund outflows and broader market weakness drive Bitcoin prices below key psychological thresholds.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Persistent fund outflows and declining altcoin prices pressured digital assets, pushing Bitcoin below $60,000.
